UpdateSourceArgs: -NoProfile -Command "$ProgressPreference='SilentlyContinue'; $git = (Get-Command git.exe -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue).Source; if (-not $git) { $git = Join-Path $env:ProgramFiles 'Git\cmd\git.exe' }; if (-not (Test-Path $git)) { Write-Output 'Error: git nenalezen - nainstaluj Git for Windows'; exit 1 }; cd arkcluster; Remove-Item srv -Recurse -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Out-Null; $DownloadSource = \"{{DownloadSource}}\"; $DownloadBranch = \"{{DownloadBranch}}\"; if (![string]::IsNullOrEmpty(\"{{DownloadUsername}}\")) { $DownloadUrl = $DownloadSource -replace \"https://\", \"https://{{DownloadUsername}}:{{DownloadPassword}}@\" } else { $DownloadUrl = \"$DownloadSource\" }; if (-Not (Test-Path .git)) { Write-Output \"Installing supervisor\"; & $git clone -q \"$DownloadUrl\" srv 1> $null; Copy-Item srv/* ./ -Recurse -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Out-Null; Copy-Item srv/.git ./ -Recurse -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Out-Null; Remove-Item srv -Recurse -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Out-Null; if ([string]::IsNullOrEmpty($DownloadBranch)) { $DownloadBranch = (& $git symbolic-ref refs/remotes/origin/HEAD) -replace '.*/' }; & $git checkout -q --force $DownloadBranch 1> $null; if ($LASTEXITCODE -eq 0) { & $git pull -q 1> $null }; if ($LASTEXITCODE -eq 0) { Write-Output \"Supervisor installed\" } else { exit 1 } } else { Write-Output \"Updating supervisor\"; & $git remote set-url origin \"$DownloadUrl\" 1> $null; if ([string]::IsNullOrEmpty($DownloadBranch)) { $DownloadBranch = (& $git symbolic-ref refs/remotes/origin/HEAD) -replace '.*/' }; & $git checkout -q --force $DownloadBranch 1> $null; if ($LASTEXITCODE -eq 0) { & $git pull -q 1> $null }; if ($LASTEXITCODE -eq 0) { Write-Output \"Supervisor updated\" } else { exit 1 } }"
/C ""{{PythonExecutable}}" -c "import sys; sys.exit(sys.version_info < (3, 7))" || (echo Error: Python nenalezen nebo je starsi nez 3.7 - uprav Python Executable v nastaveni instance. & exit /b 1)"
-c "cd arkcluster/376030/ShooterGame/Binaries && rm -rf Win64 >/dev/null 2>&1; ln -s Linux Win64"

-c "cd arkcluster && rm -rf srv >/dev/null 2>&1; DownloadSource=\"{{DownloadSource}}\"; DownloadBranch=\"{{DownloadBranch}}\"; [[ -n \"{{DownloadUsername}}\" ]] && DownloadUrl=\"${DownloadSource/https:\\/\\//https:\\/\\/{{DownloadUsername}}:{{DownloadPassword}}@}\" || DownloadUrl=\"$DownloadSource\"; [ ! -d .git ] && { echo \"Installing supervisor\" && git clone \"$DownloadUrl\" srv >/dev/null && \\cp -r srv/. ./ >/dev/null 2>&1 && rm -rf srv >/dev/null 2>&1 && [ -z \"$DownloadBranch\" ] && DownloadBranch=$(git symbolic-ref refs/remotes/origin/HEAD | sed \"s|.*/||\"); git checkout $DownloadBranch --force >/dev/null && git pull >/dev/null && echo \"Supervisor installed\"; } || { echo \"Updating supervisor\" && git remote set-url origin \"$DownloadUrl\" >/dev/null && [ -z \"$DownloadBranch\" ] && DownloadBranch=$(git symbolic-ref refs/remotes/origin/HEAD | sed \"s|.*/||\"); git checkout $DownloadBranch --force >/dev/null && git pull >/dev/null && echo \"Supervisor updated\"; }"

-c "[ -x /usr/bin/python3 ] && /usr/bin/python3 -c 'import sys; sys.exit(sys.version_info < (3, 7))' || { echo 'Error: chybi /usr/bin/python3 (aspon 3.7). Supervisor bezi na ciste standardni knihovne, staci systemovy python3: apt install python3'; exit 1; }; /usr/bin/python3 --version"
